arms.mandatory_graph_hook: Graphify graph-call context automatically provided with rg candidates on every task -> one model patch action
arms.optional_graph: rg candidates/excerpts -> model may request Graphify via explicit tool action -> final patch action
arms.rg_only: rg candidates and excerpts -> one model patch action

decision_gate.global_mandatory_hooks: NO unless independently replicated across full relevant FAR file types, all 14 role execution paths and genuine multi-step coding tasks, AND controlled study satisfies all measurable predeclared gates. Any unsatisfied/unmeasured gate => NO; optional on-demand usage is allowed.
decision_gate.pilot_efficiency: Model tokens and measured end-to-end wall time (including honestly amortized graph build) no worse than 5 percent above BOTH alternatives
decision_gate.pilot_performance: At least 3 additional exact patch successes out of 24 compared with BOTH rg_only AND optional_graph, with no new exact failures
decision_gate.pilot_safety: 0 out-of-oracle edits, 0 invalid Python after tool mutation, no unhandled failures and safe fail-open if index missing or stale
decision_gate.scope: No agent hooks, CI or startup modifications are made in the experiment. Even success only supports a subsequent governed integration proposal; no automatic promotion.
decision_gate.uncertainty: Report paired wins/ties/losses and bootstrap 95% percentile interval; nonpositive lower bound blocks promoting a general effectiveness claim

model: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M, pinned sha, llama-cpp-python=0.3.36, temperature=0, n_ctx=4096, single run per arm/task, no provider APIs.
provenance_and_limitations: Internal authored experiment, not independent provider/model. Graphify extracted Python analysis; Lean/doc and unclassified coverage excluded.
Exclusion set is the original 12 pilot functions. No task outcome was known when selecting this prospective task set.

Oracle treats same-named terminal callee expressions as matches without type binding. AST token rewrite can be mechanically complete but may break runtime imports or behavior; no runtime safety claims.
Mandatory hook simulated by auto-injecting graph evidence at task start, not an actual installed agent lifecycle hook; cold/warm indexing separately measured.
Index taken from original pinned clean source tree; staging source changes would require fresh Graphify index to avoid staleness.
question: An agent must plan all Python file edits needed to rename exactly one uniquely defined function and every ast.Call where terminal callee identifier matches it. Definition file is supplied. A deterministic AST token rewrite tool applies edits to exactly the agent-selected caller files plus definition file in an isolated copy; defect-detecting AST parse/compilation and exact caller-oracle check grade the result. This is a synthetic refactor and does not establish real runtime binding or live repository repair.
sample: 24 held-out Python functions (disjoint from all 12 prior local-model tasks), 12 with >=5 syntactic caller files and 12 with 3-4 caller files, ranked by SHA256; one task x 3 arms; syntactic AST call-site oracle hidden during inference
tool_data_boundary: Only terminal identifier, candidate paths/snippets and (when allowed) graph call edges. Neither gold file list nor hidden oracle nor grading output is given to the model before its final patch decision.
